messages:
zoe: Pushed an updated box+violin hybrid for the route dashboard. Mock: https://redwood.design/mocks/boxplus
marc: Love the hybrid. two asks: 1) make units toggle explicit in the legend (ms / s) and ensure tooltips follow it, 2) indicate when violin density is clipped
anya: Smoothing note: current default (medium) hides short-lived p99 spikes. suggest presets: none / light / adaptive with light default. adaptive should scale with variance
lee: Outlier handling idea: clip violin to 99.6% and render clipped values as outlined points with a larger hit area. hover on those points should show original value + timestamp + link to traces
zoe: Agree. UI plan: legend shows "Units (axis & tooltips)", smoothing combobox top-right, axis badge when clipping active reading "clipped: 99.6%". tooltip shows raw value, density %, and "clipped" tag if applicable
marc: Accessibility: current fill vs outline contrast fails for some colorblind palettes. use pattern fallback for violin fills at small widths and palette-v6. SR aria should be descriptive: e.g., "Latency distribution for /predict: median 40 ms; p95 130 ms; 2 outliers above 1s"
anya: Copy nit: legend helper text = "Select units used by axis and tooltips" (clearer for PMs). When switching to seconds, format ticks with 2 decimals for subsecond values
design-bot: Tasks added D-2715: units dropdown copy, smoothing presets, clipping badge + outlier interactions, palette-v6 + patterned fills, SR description + a11y checks
zoe: I'll add Storybook stories for no/light/adaptive smoothing, clipped example, and run axe snapshots. landing PR will include the aria snippet and focus styles.
